name: Product Variation Table With Quick Cart
author: WooXperto

sections.description:
Product Variation Table With Quick Cart simplifies the WooCommerce shopping experience by reducing the number of clicks required to add variable products to the cart. This plugin displays product variations in a user-friendly table format, making it easier for customers to select and purchase their desired options quickly.

Commercial Plugin

This plugin is free but offers additional paid commercial upgrades or support. View support

Key Features Free Version

  • Variation Table: Display product variations in a table format.
  • Show/Hide Variation Column: Customize which columns are visible.
  • Variation Carousel at Shop Page: Showcase variations in a carousel on the shop page.
  • Quick Cart: Add variations to the cart directly from the table.
  • Quick Cart Popup: A popup confirmation for added items.
  • Table Style: Customize the appearance of the variation table.
  • Add to Cart Icon/Text: Change the icon and text for the “Add to Cart” button.
  • Sell Price Visibility: Show or hide the sell price.

Key Features Pro Version

  • Bulk Add to Cart: Add multiple variations to the cart at once.
  • Searching Variation: Search for specific variations.
  • Variation Image Gallery: Display a gallery of variation images.
  • Full Customize Variation Table Style: Advanced styling options for the table.
  • Variation Table Style Templates: Pre-designed templates for the table.
  • Variation Swatches: Display variations as color or image swatches.
  • Variation Gallery: Showcase variation images in a gallery format.
  • Variation List: Display variations in a list format.
  • Variation Attribute Gallery: Highlight variation attributes in a gallery.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Plugin Files:
    • Download the plugin ZIP file.
    • Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Upload the ZIP file and click “Install Now.”
  2. Activate the Plugin:
    • After installation, click “Activate Plugin.”
  3. Install Required Plugins:
    • Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Configure the Plugin:
    • Go to Dashboard > Variation Table to customize the plugin.
sections.faq:
1. How does the Product Variation Table with Quick Cart work?

    • It displays variations as a table for WooCommerce variable products.

  2. Can I customize the style of the Variation table?

    • Yes, you can easily change the variation table style.

  3. Can I add to cart from the Shop page?

    • Yes, you can add to cart directly from the Shop page.

  4. Can I show/hide columns in the product variation table?

    • Yes, you can show or hide columns as needed.
